# Rexin Dynamics

> Rexin Dynamics Private Limited designs digital systems and aerial systems from
> Kochi, Kerala, India. Work is organised across Automations & Agents, Websites
> & Products, and Aerial Systems.

## Services

- Automations & Agents: AI workflow automation; voice and WhatsApp agents.
- Websites & Products: websites and web apps; Rapid MVP Sprint, defined as one
  scoped and deployable workflow in seven days once requirements are agreed.
- Aerial Systems (available engagements): custom aerial platforms, drone light
  shows, workshops and labs.
- Aerial Systems R&D: autonomous-flight research and development, scoped
  separately from available engagements.

## Delivery and invoicing

- Delivery begins with the operating context, scope, dependencies, and agreed
  handover.
- Supported invoice currencies: USD, CAD, AED, GBP, EUR, INR, AUD, SGD, NZD,
  CHF.
